assumptions_and_scope: Two-dimensional Gaussian target with S=diag(1,lambda), 0<lambda<=1, delta>0, independent scalar and vector Brownian noises, constant-step Ito Euler-Maruyama; finite-second-moment stationary laws only.
integrity: Exact symbolic algebra and numerical checks supplement, but do not replace, the proof in RESULT.md. Historical priority remains bounded by sources actually inspected.
scientific_limitations: The discrete invariant law is not explicitly identified beyond its centered covariance. The claims do not extend to nonlinear/higher-dimensional samplers, alternative discretizations, or general observables. Potential older equivalent linear-SDE stability calculations remain a historical priority risk.
title: Sharp Euler stability and nonuniform covariance bias for reversible Stratonovich Gaussian sampling
